Folks —

We need to get an official offer out to the candidate for REQ-1234 (Sr Backend Eng) by EOD Tuesday. Quick priorities / asks: 

1) Monica — can you assemble the offer packet in Greenhouse and start the approval workflow? Please use the attached comp band (RDW_COMPBAND_GRADE_G4.pdf) and the job sheet (REQ-1234-job-sheet.docx).

2) Routing rules:
  - Hiring Manager (me) approve first for base/bonus structure
  - Talent Ops (Laura) runs the sign-off for internal headcount/headcount freeze checks
  - Finance (Marissa) needs to confirm total OTE and equity band before sending to candidate
  - Legal is not required for standard IC offers but loop in if any deviation from the template

3) Approvals required for comp above Grade 4: explicit CFO ok (we're within Grade 4 so regular Finance approval should suffice). If the comp requires a one-time sign-on > $25k, escalate to me and Marissa.

4) Candidate-facing material: attach short candidate-offer-summary (see attached draft). Once approvals complete, Monica please trigger DocuSign and copy me on the envelope.

Timeline: assemble today, routing tomorrow morning, out to candidate Tuesday.

Thanks —
Karthik
